description: Unified Task domain model + CI/CD-style Pipeline View for issue detail page

tasks.title: Backend unified task model — types, repo, event registration, recordTaskResult helper
tasks.description: Define StageTask and StageTaskResult interfaces in stage-context.ts. Narrow StageExecutionRepo.taskResults from unknown[] to StageTaskResult[], add findByIssueId() method. Register stage_task_update in EventBus EventMap and ALL_EVENT_TYPES. Add protected recordTaskResult(ctx, result) to BaseStageRunner that reads current taskResults, appends the new StageTaskResult, and writes back.
acceptanceCriteria: StageTask and StageTaskResult types are defined and exported from stage-context.ts
StageExecutionRepo.taskResults is typed as StageTaskResult[]
StageExecutionRepo.findByIssueId returns records ordered by created_at ASC
stage_task_update is in EventMap with correct payload shape
stage_task_update is in ALL_EVENT_TYPES array in events.ts
BaseStageRunner.recordTaskResult appends a StageTaskResult and persists to DB
npm run build passes
npm test passes
tasks.notes: This is the foundation task. Types, repo method, event registration, and the base runner helper are all needed before any stage runner or frontend can use them.

tasks.title: Plan and Check stage runners emit stage_task_update + record results incrementally
tasks.description: Rename RoundConfig to TaskConfig in PlanStageRunner and CheckStageRunner. At each task start, emit stage_task_update with status='started' (alongside existing plan_round_start). At each task completion, call recordTaskResult and emit stage_task_update with status='completed'. For skipped tasks (checkpoint hit), record with status='skipped'. Track per-task start time to compute duration. Keep all old event emissions unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: PlanStageRunner emits stage_task_update for each of 5 tasks on start and completion
CheckStageRunner emits stage_task_update for each of 2 tasks on start and completion
After Plan stage completes, stage_executions.task_results contains 5 StageTaskResult entries
After Check stage completes, stage_executions.task_results contains 2 StageTaskResult entries
Skipped tasks (checkpoint) produce StageTaskResult with status='skipped'
Old events (plan_round_start, plan_session_update) still emit unchanged
Each StageTaskResult has correct taskId, duration > 0, and artifacts array
npm run build passes
npm test passes
tasks.notes: Both Plan and Check use the same pattern: iterate tasks, emit on start/complete, record result. They share the TaskConfig shape so implement them together.

tasks.title: Build stage runner (RalphExecutor) emits stage_task_update + records results
tasks.description: In RalphExecutor, add stage_task_update emission alongside existing ralph_task_update at task start, completion, failure, and retry points. In BuildStageRunner, extend the onTaskCompleted callback to also call recordTaskResult with the task's StageTaskResult. Pass stage context through RalphExecutorContext so it can access stageExecutionId and stageExecutionRepo.
acceptanceCriteria: RalphExecutor emits stage_task_update alongside ralph_task_update for started/completed/failed/retrying
BuildStageRunner records StageTaskResult for each completed Build task via onTaskCompleted
stage_task_update payload includes stage='build', taskId from tasks.json, taskTitle, and correct attempt count
Old ralph_task_update and ralph_loop_progress events still emit unchanged
npm run build passes
npm test passes
tasks.notes: RalphExecutor already has the task lifecycle hooks (emit at start/complete/fail/retry). Add parallel stage_task_update emission at each point. BuildStageRunner's onTaskCompleted is the integration point for recordTaskResult.

tasks.title: GET /api/issues/:number/executions endpoint
tasks.description: Add a new route GET /api/issues/:number/executions to api/issues.ts. Look up the issue by number, then call StageExecutionRepo.findByIssueId to get all execution records. Return them as { data: StageExecution[] } with taskResults as StageTaskResult[] and checkResults as CheckResult[]. Return 404 if issue not found. Return { data: [] } for issues with no executions.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/executions returns 200 with array of stage execution records
Each record includes id, stage, status, taskResults (StageTaskResult[]), checkResults, createdAt, updatedAt
Records are ordered by createdAt ascending
Returns 404 for non-existent issue
Returns { data: [] } for draft issue with no executions
npm run build passes
npm test passes
tasks.notes: Needs access to StageExecutionRepo. The stateManager.getStageExecutionRepo() is already available in the route factory. Issue lookup uses existing issueService.getByNumber or the issue repo.

tasks.title: Frontend types + usePipelineView hook + API client + SSE subscription
tasks.description: Add frontend types for StageTaskResult, StageExecution (API response shape), and StageTaskUpdateEvent to lib/types.ts. Add stage_task_update to AgentDetailEventMap and AGENT_DETAIL_EVENTS. Add useIssueExecutions query hook calling GET /api/issues/:number/executions. Create usePipelineView hook that merges API data (completed stages) with live stage_task_update SSE events (running stage), using RAF-throttled event batching at 100ms. Expose the merged pipeline state: stages with their task/check statuses.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend StageTaskResult and StageExecution types match backend API response shape
stage_task_update is in AgentDetailEventMap with correct payload type
stage_task_update is in AGENT_DETAIL_EVENTS array
useIssueExecutions fetches from GET /api/issues/:number/executions
usePipelineView merges API history with live SSE events
RAF throttling batches rapid stage_task_update events at 100ms intervals
npm run build passes (frontend)
tasks.notes: The usePipelineView hook is the data layer for all Pipeline View components. It must handle: initial API fetch, SSE subscription for live updates, RAF throttling, and merging historical + live data.

tasks.title: PipelineView + StageBar + StepList + InlineApproval components
tasks.description: Create PipelineView component composing StageBar, StepList, and InlineApproval. StageBar renders horizontal Plan→Build→Check→Done with status icons and elapsed timers, clickable to select stage. StepList shows Tasks section (expandable rows with status icon + title + duration + artifacts) and Checks section (pass/fail/pending rows). InlineApproval renders inside Checks when user-approval is awaiting, with Approve/Send back buttons and feedback input. Handle all issue states: backlog (grey + Start), active (live), blocked (failed icon), interrupted (resume button), completed (all passed), closed (greyed out).
acceptanceCriteria: StageBar renders 4 stages with correct status icons for each issue state
Clicking a completed stage in StageBar switches StepList to that stage's history
Clicking the current stage returns to live view
StepList Tasks section shows each task with status icon, title, duration, expandable artifacts
StepList Checks section shows each check with pass/fail/pending icon and name
InlineApproval shows Approve/Send back buttons with feedback input when user-approval is awaiting
Backlog issue shows 4 grey stages + Start button
Blocked issue shows failed icon on current stage + failure reason
Interrupted issue shows resume button
Completed issue shows all stages passed
Closed issue shows greyed out non-interactive pipeline
Running stage elapsed timer updates every second
tasks.notes: These are pure presentation components that consume data from usePipelineView hook. Use Tailwind CSS classes matching existing IssueDetailPage styling. Status icons can use simple unicode/emoji or SVG — keep it minimal.

tasks.title: IssueDetailPage integration + old component deletion
tasks.description: Replace IssueTimeline, TaskList, CheckSuitePanel, CheckResultsPanel, and approval sidebar in IssueDetailPage with the new PipelineView component. Delete the old component files (IssueTimeline.tsx, TaskList.tsx, CheckSuitePanel.tsx, CheckResultsPanel.tsx). Delete or mark deprecated useIssueTimeline.ts and useSessionTimeline.ts hooks. Keep BranchBar, Description, ChangesPanel, Comments, SessionList, and Details sidebar unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueDetailPage imports PipelineView instead of IssueTimeline, TaskList, CheckSuitePanel, CheckResultsPanel
IssueTimeline.tsx, TaskList.tsx, CheckSuitePanel.tsx, CheckResultsPanel.tsx are deleted
PipelineView renders at the top of the issue detail content area, above ChangesPanel
BranchBar, Description, ChangesPanel, Comments, SessionList are preserved unchanged
No import errors or TypeScript errors in IssueDetailPage
npm run build passes (frontend + backend)
npm test passes
tasks.notes: This is the final integration task. Verify that the issue detail page renders correctly for all issue states (backlog, active, blocked, interrupted, completed, closed). The old components have no other consumers so deletion is safe.
